Package com.cockroachlabs.crdb.ai

package com.cockroachlabs.crdb.ai
AI integration over CockroachDB's native VECTOR type.

VectorStore is the high-level document store (schema init, embedding, upsert, delete, similarity search); VectorSearchTemplate is the low-level search engine over arbitrary tables. DistanceMetric maps L2/cosine/inner-product to CockroachDB's <->/<=>/<#> operators and index operator classes.

Embeddings come from a pluggable EmbeddingProvider (with a dependency-free HashingEmbeddingProvider for tests/demos); RagTemplate combines retrieval with a pluggable ChatModel for RAG.

    A trivial, deterministic ChatModel that echoes the question and the retrieved context instead of calling a real LLM.
    EmbeddingProvider
    Converts text into a vector embedding for storage in a CockroachDB VECTOR column.
    HashingEmbeddingProvider
    A deterministic, dependency-free EmbeddingProvider that hashes whitespace-delimited tokens into a fixed-dimension bag-of-words vector and L2-normalizes the result.
    RagTemplate
    A minimal Retrieval-Augmented Generation helper: retrieve the most similar documents from a VectorStore, then hand their content to a ChatModel to generate a grounded answer.
